summary: Stripe webhook: period end now from current_period_end instead of ended_at (null -> 1970, paying users never Pro); handles async_payment_succeeded; database updates wrapped in try/catch that only logs, still returning 200. Billing button loading cleanup; adds local .cursor/mcp.json.

statements.text: If saving to your database fails in your Stripe webhook, the error is caught and Stripe is still told it worked, so it won't try again. A customer can pay and never get what they paid for. Answer with 500.
statements.why: webhooks/stripe/route.ts catches and only logs db failures, then returns 200.
